attempts.text:
Pintu Pandey
Artificial Intelligence | Machine Learning | Digital Transformation | Team Leadership
Highly skilled professional with 8+ years of experience; targeting assignments in AI & ML or Digital Transformation with an organization of high 
repute to drive mutual growth and lead high performing teams towards excellence.

	+91 9466392562
	LinkedIn  pintupandey89ai@gmail.com

	Education

B.Tech in Computer Science from
RTU university, Kota in 2012




Core Competencies

	 Machine Learning Model Deployment
	 Generative AI Solutions
	 Real-time Anomaly Detection
	 Natural Language Processing Techniques
	 AI/ML System Architecture
	 AI Model Optimization
	 Cloud AI Services
	 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
	 Performance Monitoring and 
Reporting
	 Stakeholder Management
	 Cross-functional Collaboration


Certifications

	 5-day Generative AI Google course by 
Kaggle
	 Generative AI Architectures with LLM, 
Prompt, RAG, Vector DB from Udemy


IT Skills

	 AI / ML:
		o Machine learning – Scikit learn, 
Pandas, Numpy, Matplotlib, 
Seaborn.
	o Deep learning – Tensorflow, Keras,



PyTorch
		o Generative AI / Agentic AI – LLMs 
(OpenAI, Gemini, llama, Gemma, 
GPT) Embedding models (SBERT, 
Gemini, Open AI), Vector DBs 
(Chroma, FAISS, Pinecone), Retrieval 
Augmented Generation (RAG), 
LangChain, Llamaindex, LangGraph.


	 Programming & Databases: Python, 
SQL, API Development
	 Web Frameworks: FastAPI, Flask, 
Node.js
	 Cloud & DevOps: MLOps, ML Flow, 
AWS Sagemaker
	 Automation / BI / Other:  Power BI, Qlik 
Sense, Excel.

	Profile Summary

	 Proficient in designing, developing, and implementing advanced AI/ML solutions that resolve 
intricate business challenges and support strategic growth across industries.
	 Experienced in managing full-cycle AI/ML project execution, including data preprocessing, 
model development, deployment, and optimization, ensuring effective and scalable outcomes.
	 Skilled in managing end-to-end AI/ML system integration, ensuring that machine learning 
models are seamlessly embedded into business operations, improving process efficiency and 
decision-making.
	 Experienced in developing MLOps pipelines, establishing continuous integration and 
continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices for AI models, ensuring automated workflows and 
model version control for seamless deployment and maintenance.
	 Skilled in utilizing vector databases (Chroma, FAISS, Pinecone) to enable high-performance 
data storage, retrieval, and querying, supporting advanced semantic search and knowledge 
discovery for data-driven decision-making.
	 Proficient in Power BI and Qlik Sense, with expertise in designing insightful and visually 
appealing dashboards tailored for CFOs and CEOs.
	 Experienced in applying Agile methodologies (Scrum) to manage AI/ML project development, 
ensuring adaptive planning, incremental progress, and the timely delivery of high-quality 
results.


Work Experience

Manager, Digital Transformation | BDO India LLP | Jun 2023 – Sep 2025

	 Textile FinanceBot (Conversational AI for CFO): Designed and implemented an AI-powered 
chatbot to assist CFOs in the textile industry with financial insights and FAQs. Defined the 
problem statement, prepared the Statement of Qualifications (SOQ), and built the technical 
architecture. Developed FAQ handling with semantic routing and integrated a Streamlit-based 
UI for seamless user interaction. Enhanced decision support by automating query resolution 
and enabling intuitive financial data access.


Manager | ITC Infotech | Jun 2022- Jun 2023
	 Healthcare Premium Prediction (Regression): Developed a machine learning model to predict 
healthcare insurance premiums based on demographic and medical attributes. Performed 
data preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify key 
cost drivers. Implemented regression algorithms (Linear Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost) 
and optimized hyperparameters to improve accuracy. Evaluated model performance using 
RMSE and R², enabling data-driven pricing strategies for insurers.


LTI - Larsen & Toubro InfoTech | Nov 2020 - May 2022
	 Credit Risk Modeling (Classification): Built a machine learning model to assess 
creditworthiness and predict loan default risk using customer demographic, financial, and 
behavioral data. Conducted data cleaning, feature selection, and class imbalance handling 
(SMOTE/undersampling). Applied classification algorithms (Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, 
Random Forest, XGBoost) and fine-tuned hyperparameters for optimal performance. 
Evaluated models using AUC-ROC, precision, recall, and F1-score, delivering a robust solution 
to support risk-based lending decisions.

🛠 Previous Experience

Sr. Data Analysis | Team Computers | July 2019 – Nov 2020

Programmer Analyst | Aegis Pvt. Ltd | Nov 2016 – Mar 2018



https://www.linkedin.com/in/pintu-pandey-5b06a852/
https://gartner.udemy.com/course/generative-ai-architectures-with-llm-prompt-rag-vector-db/
https://gartner.udemy.com/course/generative-ai-architectures-with-llm-prompt-rag-vector-db/
